'''''Portraits of the Galactic Civil War''''' was a publication compiled by the journalist [[Cindel Towani]] that was released in [[41 ABY]]. The publication included an account by the [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Hume Tarl/Legends|Hume Tarl]] of his experiences during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
